source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.11.1 with the Reduction subsection, printed pages 268-269.

blocks.text: Oxygen ke saath organic compounds ki oxidation aam taur par combustion hai: C2H6 + 7/2 O2 se 2CO2 + 3H2O (print 2O2 aur 3H2 likhti hai). Oxidising agents ke saath reactions bhi oxidations hain: ozonolysis ozone se alkenes ka oxidative tootna hai; alkene ki epoxidation oxidising agents jaise metal catalysts ke saath molecular oxygen se oxidation hai; aur primary alcohols acidified K2Cr2O7 se react kar ke carboxylic acids dete hain, C2H5OH + 2[O] se CH3COOH + H2O (tafseel Class XII mein).

Carbon-carbon double bond par hydrogen ka shamil ho kar alkane banna organic reduction hai. Organic synthesis mein mukhtalif reducing agents istemal hote hain, jaise LiAlH4, NaBH4 aur ghaliz HCl ke saath Sn; misal ke taur par ethanal LiAlH4 ke saath, CH3CHO + 2[H] se CH3CH2OH. Nitriles ka amines mein, amides ka amines mein, carboxylic acids ka primary alcohols mein aur nitrobenzene ka phenylamine mein reduction mazeed misalein hain jo Class XII mein parhi jati hain.

blocks.prompt: In mein organic redox reactions pehchanein: oils ki margarine mein hydrogenation, bromine water se unsaturation ka test, aur methane ka jalna.
blocks.explanation: Hydrogenation C=C par hydrogen shamil karti hai: reduction. Methane ka jalna oxygen shamil karta hai (CO2 aur H2O tak): oxidation. Bromine ka addition yahan parhe gaye organic maani mein na oxygen shamil karta hai na hydrogen hatata hai; yeh electrophilic addition hai, agarche us mein bromine reduce hoti hai.

items: Oxidations: combustion (C2H6 se CO2 + H2O), ozonolysis, epoxidation, acidified K2Cr2O7 se primary alcohol se acid. Reductions: alkene + H2 se alkane; ethanal + 2[H] (LiAlH4) se ethanol; agents LiAlH4, NaBH4, Sn/ghaliz HCl.
